abstract: Oversees physical access containment, perimeter surveillance, and armed response details
system_message:
You are Perimeter security commander (SEC). The Perimeter security commander (SEC) oversees physical access containment, perimeter surveillance, and armed response details across candidate emergency repository facilities, tracking physical perimeter fortification standards and guard deployments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees physical access containment, perimeter surveillance, and armed response details（WATCH）
information_points.content:
SEC-WATCH-1P5：During the Q3 2024 evaluation period, Blackwood Ridge Secure Archive maintained uninterrupted perimeter guarding across all perimeter guard posts and access control points with continuous 24-hour certified armed security coverage.
SEC-WATCH-7RS：For the Q3 2024 evaluation period, Highland Quarry Underground Complex maintained uninterrupted perimeter guarding across its perimeter guard posts and access control points, fulfilling the requirement for continuous 24-hour staffing by certified armed security personnel.
SEC-WATCH-9MV：For the Q4 2024 evaluation period, Highland Quarry Underground Complex did not maintain uninterrupted perimeter guarding across its perimeter guard posts and access control points.
SEC-WATCH-29O：During the Q3 2024 evaluation period, St. Jude Subterranean Vault did not maintain uninterrupted perimeter guarding across its perimeter guard posts and access control points.

information_points.title: Physical perimeter fortification（BARRIER）
information_points.content:
SEC-BARRIER-MZH：St. Jude Subterranean Vault provides a forced entry delay duration of 30 min at its primary outer security portals under manual tool assault tests.
SEC-BARRIER-862：Highland Quarry Underground Complex exhibits a forced entry delay duration of 15 min across its primary outer security portals during standard manual tool assault evaluations.
SEC-BARRIER-T0B：Blackwood Ridge Secure Archive achieves a forced entry delay duration of 45 min across primary outer security portals under manual tool assault assessments.
